summary_markdown: Sensors were physically moved in the mall, and antennas were relocated above screens. Additionally, sensors previously noted as problematic were reflashed by someone. Someone requested feedback regarding the changes in the mall (specifically where antennas were raised) to determine if these actions resolved the issues with the problematic sensors and to coordinate next steps.
decisions: A review of the mall sensor setup is required.
action_items: Someone needs to check the mall setup today and provide feedback on the sensor changes.
